title: Read the error, then repair it
starter:
let average (xs : int list) : int =
  List.fold_left (fun acc x -> acc + x) 0 xs / List.length xs
hints: Run it and read the failing test. The exception is named `Division_by_zero`. Which number in this function can be 0?
`List.length xs` is 0 for the empty list. Answer that case before you divide.
`match xs with [] -> 0 | _ -> List.fold_left (fun acc x -> acc + x) 0 xs / List.length xs`.
explain: The reference is `match xs with [] -> 0 | _ -> List.fold_left (fun acc x -> acc + x) 0 xs / List.length xs`. The error named the problem: a division by zero. The only divisor is `List.length xs`, and the smallest input that makes it 0 is the empty list, so that case gets its own answer.
